adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): Atlas/exemplar-pool updates belong to PPO training. The post-training inference policy uses fixed learned artifacts, so the system is T1. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
